description: This PHP source file defines the AuthValidateController class, which handles authentication validation requests in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for retrieving authentication services, handling HTTP requests, and generating HTTP responses related to user authentication.

classes.name: AuthValidateController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for validating user authentication by processing HTTP requests and returning JSON responses indicating success or failure.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of AuthenticationService used for credential validation.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming HTTP request to validate user credentials and returns a JSON response indicating success or failure.
